# Bingu Tech — Enterprise AI Consultancy & Automation Provider

> Established in 1996, Bingu Tech is a Kenyan AI consultancy specializing in sovereign enterprise AI deployments, localized RAG architectures, and autonomous multi-agent swarms.

## Core Commercial Solutions
- **Autonomous Multi-Agent Swarms:** Self-hosted reasoning agents integrated into enterprise ERP networks.
- **Sovereign RAG & Data Systems:** On-premise vector databases with 100% data sovereignty.
- **Edge AI & Offline Compute:** Quantized open-weight model deployments (Llama/Mistral) for localized infrastructure.

## Ecosystem & Sub-Brands
- **Bingu AI Academy:** Specialized B2B/B2C workforce upskilling and agentic system training.
- **254 AI Hub:** Pro-bono youth digital upskilling community initiative supported by Bingu Tech.
